dossier.scp_unleashed.303.title: The Doorman
dossier.scp_unleashed.303.caption: SCP-303 photographed through the window of a storeroom door it was holding shut.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-303 cannot be held by walls, locks or guards, and it is never where it was last seen. The only arrangement that has held it is an ordinary door, prepared as set out in %rProcedure 303-T%r. The procedure calls for a length of good timber and a certain mineral. The rest of it is %rrestricted%r.
**Once the door of its cell is shut, it is not to be opened, knocked on or handled for any reason.**

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-303 is a very tall humanoid, roughly three metres in height, with broad shoulders, long arms and dark red skin. It has no eyes, nose or ears. Its head is a smooth, hood-like dome, and almost all of the front of it is one wide mouth of large, flat, human-like teeth.
SCP-303 makes no vocal sound. Its heavy footsteps are usually the only sign that it is near.

It follows one person at a time, at a distance and out of sight. When that person walks through a door and on, the door closes behind them. SCP-303 is then found folded up on the other side, watching through the window, and the door will not open for the person it watches.

page.title: Addendum 303-1: Interview
text: R-12 was shut out of their own kitchen for most of an hour: "It was folded right up against the glass. It never moved. It was smiling, or that is just what its face is."
Every report on file comes from someone who was alone at the time.

page.title: Addendum 303-2: Incident Log
text: Incident 303-04: D-7720 broke through a held door with a fire axe. %rThe corridor beyond was empty.%r The door was a total loss.
Incident 303-07: heavy, very fast footsteps were heard behind a held door as a second researcher walked up to it. Nothing was seen.

page.title: Addendum 303-3: Note
page.text: Found taped to the inside of Dr. %rOkafor%r's office door: "If you hear heavy footsteps behind you, do not go through the next door alone."

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp303_doorman_sp: SCP-303, the Doorman: a very tall, broad figure with a mouth where its face should be. It is silent apart from heavy footsteps.
It follows people from a distance and keeps out of sight. It takes an interest in ordinary doors, and in whoever walks through them.
It does not occur naturally. Its archive file has more on where it comes from.
